title: Siman 379
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: בְּעֵינֵיהֶם מְאד תַּאֲוָה זוֹ. כַּמּוּבָא כַּמָּה מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת בַּגְּמָרָא כִּי אֶצְלִי אֵינוֹ כְּלוּם,
segments.en: (41.) Once the Aleph-Beis book [Sefer HaMidos] was in manuscript with our friend Rabbi Naftali. And Rabbi Naftali sat with him on the wagon — for he was accompanying him when he traveled to Navoritch. He answered and said about the Aleph-Beis book that he saw in the hand of the aforementioned Rabbi Naftali: "My dear, heartfelt friend — my dear, faithful friend. This — this made me into a Jew!" [in Yiddish: "hot dos hot mich gimacht far ain Yehud"]. Meaning: through those matters stated in the Aleph-Beis book about every single character trait — through this he was strengthened...
